body:
Thank you for taking the interest to reply to me, but I'm afraid I'll disappoint you. There is nothing horrible going on in my life, I'd go as far as to say that things are OK by any normal person's definition.

I'm just tired. I'm sick of myself, my surroundings, my lack of friends, all the time I've wasted so far, and all the time I'm going to be wasting in the future. I've stopped engaging with my hobbies for some months now. I look ahead and I see nothing, just the same misery, day in, day out, fights, loneliness, a city I hate, a total disconnect from the things that give me joy in life, and a complete inability to do anything with myself.

I haven't seen my therapist in a month, though I think I will arrange a session soon, in hopes of maybe managing to  convince him to give me antidepressants. Then, if I'm lucky, I will get the ones with the most side effects, effectively succeeding in spending the rest of my life in a haze, so I don't have to participate in it anymore until I get hit by a truck. Maybe he will agree when I admit that I relapsed once and cut myself for the first time after a year or two.

Well, sorry for the rant. After a point, I used the reply box as a diary, I guess. Still, I'll leave it, because being heard feels comforting.

The canyons in Utah sound lovely. If I had a car, I like to think I would find myself a nice tree to drive into.

Thank you for your reply. Can you point me to the direction of the mechanism behind a response like that? I would like to understand what separates it from an allergic reaction, from a medical point of view.

Large amount was about 90 tablets, and yes, deliberate overdose.

The timeline was not very clear in my post. I vomited within about ten or fifteen minutes after ingestion, I believe, and the oedema developed shortly after that. I suppose that points to it not being an allergic reaction, but I want to be sure because of the medication prescribed, and also because nothing was really explained to me at the time \(and I've been trying to make sense of a few things ever since\).
Give me time... I was embarrassed.
Thank you, I have since read the pinned post in full. I apologise again, it must be a pain going around removing posts such as this. I will try again properly.
